sources.title: GitHub - ajinkyagorad/smol-vla-lerobot-so100
sources.snippet: 🤖 LeRobot SmolVLA Pipeline: LEGO Pick & Place with SO100 Robot This repository documents a complete workflow using the lerobot library to train and evaluate robot policies using imitation learning. The task involves picking a yellow LEGO cube and placing it inside a white LEGO frame using the SO100 follower robot.
